blocks.text: Blockchain 2.0 cryptocurrency se aage khasusiyat deta hai: smart contracts, decentralized applications (dApps) aur behtar tausee. Smart contracts khud chalne wale contracts hain jin ki shartein code mein hain; jaidad mein yeh adaigi aur milkiyat ki jaanch mukammal hote hi khareedar ko milkiyat aur bechne wale ko raqam khud muntaqil kar sakta hai.

blocks.prompt: Blockchain 2.0 bunyadi cryptocurrency se aage kya laata hai (MCQ 10)? Blockchain 2.0 aur us ki khasusiyat bataiye (long question 6).
blocks.explanation: (b) decentralized applications aur smart contracts. Blockchain 1.0 zyada tar currency ki muntaqili darj karta tha; Blockchain 2.0, jaise Ethereum par, chain par programs chalata hai. Smart contracts muahide khud nafiz karte (jaidad ki farokht, insurance adaigi); dApps aisi applications hain jin ki mantaq ek company ke server ki bajaye blockchain par chalti hai; aur behtar tausee zyada transactions mumkin banati hai. Yeh blockchain ko maaliyat, supply chains, jaidad aur insurance mein le aate hain.

items: Blockchain 2.0: smart contracts, dApps, behtar tausee (jaidad ki muntaqili ki misal).
